# gitlab_admin_role (Resource)

The `gitlab_admin_role` resource manages the lifecycle of a custom admin role.

Custom admin roles allow an organization to grant read-only access to the Admin Area without granting Administrator access to the whole instance.

Unlike `gitlab_member_role`, admin roles have no `base_access_level` and are not scoped to a group, since they grant access to instance-wide administration rather than to a namespace.

-> This resource requires an Ultimate license and is only available for GitLab Self-Managed.

**Upstream API**: [GitLab GraphQL API docs](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/graphql/reference/#mutationmemberroleadmincreate)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example is creating a custom admin role for an auditor, with read-only access to several Admin Area pages.

resource "gitlab_admin_role" "example" {
  name        = "Auditor"
  description = "Read-only access to the Admin Area for auditing purposes"
  enabled_permissions = [
    "READ_ADMIN_CICD",
    "READ_ADMIN_GROUPS",
    "READ_ADMIN_MONITORING",
    "READ_ADMIN_PROJECTS",
    "READ_ADMIN_SUBSCRIPTION",
    "READ_ADMIN_USERS",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled_permissions` (Set of String) All permissions enabled for the admin role. Valid values are: `READ_ADMIN_CICD`, `READ_ADMIN_GROUPS`, `READ_ADMIN_MONITORING`, `READ_ADMIN_PROJECTS`, `READ_ADMIN_SUBSCRIPTION`, `READ_ADMIN_USERS`
- `name` (String) Name for the admin role.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description for the admin role.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp of when the admin role was created.
- `edit_path` (String) The Web UI path to edit the admin role
- `id` (String) Globally unique ID of the admin role. In the format of `gid://gitlab/MemberRole/1`
- `iid` (Number) The id integer value extracted from the `id` attribute

## Import

Starting in Terraform v1.5.0, you can use an [import block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import `gitlab_admin_role`. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = gitlab_admin_role.example
  id = "see CLI command below for ID"
}
```

Importing using the CLI is supported with the following syntax:

```shell
# GitLab admin role can be imported using the id made up of `gid://gitlab/MemberRole/<ID>` for example:

terraform import gitlab_admin_role.example 'gid://gitlab/MemberRole/123'
```
